maria (devex): Heads up — onboarding bug: Async Python client + Dedicated + corporate HTTP proxy + custom CA via REDWOOD_SSL_CA fails TLS on first request. Minimal repro below.

maria (devex): repro: export REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://dedicated-acct.internal; export HTTPS_PROXY=http://corp-proxy:3128; export REDWOOD_SSL_CA=/etc/ssl/corp-ca.pem; run quickstart async sample -> ssl.SSLError TLSV1_ALERT_UNKNOWN_CA on first call.

devon (sdk): Repro sounds like aiohttp connector not receiving SSLContext when proxy is used. We create default connector lazily but may not attach cafile.

sam (infra): Also check if client builds connector at import time; env changes in same shell won't be picked up. That would explain first-request-only failures.

olivia (eng): Temporary workaround for support: create ssl.SSLContext with cafile and pass to AsyncClient constructor. Add snippet to quickstart.

maria (devex): Customers expect env-only flow to work; we need SDK to honor REDWOOD_SSL_CA with proxy automatically.

devon (sdk): I'll open a PR: ensure AsyncClient constructs aiohttp.TCPConnector with ssl context when REDWOOD_SSL_CA present and when HTTPS_PROXY is set; add unit tests and a friendly RedwoodSSLConfigurationError wrapping SSLError.

sam (infra): Review connector reuse to avoid per-client leaks.

olivia (eng): I'll update docs with a health-check snippet and the explicit workaround until fix lands.

maria (devex): Great. Leaving open until PR merges and docs updated.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for branch fix/async-proxy-ca (staging). ETA 15m.
